standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-higher-direct-image (invoked at proof line 1500)
standard_prerequisites.use: With an affine target $Y'$ it makes $R^if'_*\mathcal{F}'$ a quasi-coherent module whose global sections compute $H^i(X', \mathcal{F}')$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Leray identification and vanishing on an affine space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology on Sites, label sites-cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray (invoked at proof line 1503) and Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label proposition-vanishing (invoked at proof line 1506)
standard_prerequisites.use: Together they turn the vanishing of the higher direct images into the vanishing of $H^i(X', \mathcal{F}')$ over an affine base.

standard_prerequisites.name: The collection of covers and degrees attached to a quasi-separated space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-vanishing-quasi-separated (invoked at proof lines 1510 and 1515)
standard_prerequisites.use: Its choices for $X$, base changed to $X'$, give the vanishing $H^i(X', \mathcal{F}') = 0$ for $i \geq \max(p + d_p)$, which is the bound asserted.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine target: for a surjective etale $V \to Y$ with $V$ affine, the higher direct images over $Y$ restrict to those of the base changed morphism, so the bound for $V \times_Y X \to V$ works for $f$ (proof lines 1482-1494).
Further reduce to affine $Y'$: it suffices to prove the vanishing for all $Y' \to Y$ with $Y'$ affine, since the vanishing is checked on such base changes (proof lines 1496-1498).
With $Y'$ affine, use quasi-coherence of $R^if'_*\mathcal{F}'$ and the Leray identification to reduce to $H^i(X', \mathcal{F}') = 0$ (proof lines 1499-1506).

Base change the choices supplied by the quasi-separated vanishing lemma to $X'$ and conclude that $H^i(X', \mathcal{F}') = 0$ for $i \geq \max(p + d_p)$, giving the claimed integer $n(X \to Y)$ (proof lines 1508-1517).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to an affine target by etale base change (proof lines 1482-1494).
Reduction to an affine source of the base change (proof lines 1496-1498).
From higher direct images to cohomology on $X'$ (proof lines 1499-1506).
Base change of the quasi-separated vanishing choices (proof lines 1508-1517).
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a single integer, depending only on the morphism, past which all higher direct images of quasi-coherent sheaves vanish, uniformly over arbitrary base changes of the target (statement lines 1465-1479). The proof reduces to an affine target by etale base change, then to affine base changes, translates the statement into the vanishing of the cohomology of $X'$ via quasi-coherence and Leray, and finally transports the covers and degree bounds provided by the quasi-separated vanishing lemma through the base change. The two reductions and the transport of the bound are the substance, so the claim is H2.
